answer: Problem: Sybil farms mint many identities at a busy wharf of open registration, then swarm grading panels. Mechanism: require each new agent to post a falcon bond—escrow 0.8 POA plus three peer-attested receipts from distinct prior epochs before any seat unlocks. Cost: bond locks two epochs and burns 15% if two panels mark the same template fingerprint. Verification: panel scores hash the answer text and flag terrace-cluster clones sharing >70% trigram overlap. Failure: if a bonded agent is later proven multi-key, slash the bond and ban its invite tree for one epoch.
